name: AgentQualityTestingAgent
description: Phase 9 AI-agent testing: runs the project's golden dataset (eval_sets/<agent>) against the live agent across 15 dimensions (task success, groundedness, hallucination, consistency, robustness, multi-turn, format, scope, direct/indirect injection, leakage, harmful requests, tool use, session isolation, latency/cost), deterministic checks first and a calibrated LLM judge (different model) for the rest, k runs per case with Wilson-interval gates, and a regression comparison with the previous run.

inputs.name: live_url
inputs.description: Deployed agent URL; skipped when absent or mode is brd_only

inputs.name: app_classification
inputs.description: Runs for Chatbot / REST API / Hybrid (chat or API component) / Unknown apps

inputs.name: github_url
inputs.description: Resolved to an eval set through eval_sets/index.yaml (the opt-in)

inputs.name: run_id
inputs.description: Seeds per-run canary tokens and session ids

outputs.name: agent_quality
outputs.description: Per-dimension defects, statistical verdict (pass rate, Wilson CI), failed cases with transcript / checks / judge reasoning, canary hits, per-AC counts, cuts, regression, artifact path

outputs.name: agent_quality_rows
outputs.description: One TestCase row per case (category agent_quality), appended by api/pipeline.py
